title: DSH advice entry array (dsh-advice/1)
description: The additive `advice[]` field of a dsh-conformance/1 report. One entry per (check, key) finding; advice never changes the verdict. 13 fields are required; `ruleMissing` is an optional diagnostic emitted when spec/remediation.json has no rule for a key. `version` is the producing package version, not this schema version.

key.description: Clause or gate key the advice is attached to (for example C-2.2).

gate.description: Result of the owning check after report adjustments.

title.description: Short human title; falls back to the key when the rule table has no title.

why.description: Why the finding matters; null when the rule table has no explanation.

fix.description: Concrete remediation; null when the rule table has no fix.

docsUrl.description: Release-pinned documentation URL; null when the rule has no docs anchor.

source.description: Check id that produced the finding (DSC-xx).

reason.description: Diagnostic reason(s); may be empty. Not used for the verdict.

occurrences.description: How many duplicate details were merged into this entry.

advisory.description: True when the owning check is advisory and never moves the verdict.

ruleMissing.description: Optional diagnostic: spec/remediation.json has no rule for `key`.
